We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The case: Zhu colluded with Liu to inflate assessment of factory floor area and structure to increase demolition compensation, then they got 100+ million RMB compensation, Zhu paid 55 million to Liu etc. This is fraud (诈骗) by collusion to obtain compensation. Also possibly "行贿" or "受贿"? Zhu is the one who offered to split the benefit, but he is not a public official. Liu is a company actual person, not a public official. So it's not bribery.
